capabilities: Sync RoveNotes recordings into the vault as markdown files with frontmatter
Embed each recording's .ogg audio inline for playback in Reading Mode
Create pages for handwritten notes with recognized markdown and AI summaries
Reconcile continuously so renames, late transcripts, and deletions propagate
Link the vault to a RoveNotes account via an 8-character device code
extras: Requires a paid RoveNotes Pro account for API access; desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true, mobile unsupported); the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: RoveNotes recordings and handwritten notes live outside the vault, so their transcripts, summaries, and audio can't be read or searched alongside other notes.

relations.evidence: Sync your RoveNotes voice recordings and handwritten notes into your Obsidian vault as markdown files

requires.name: RoveNotes Pro (API access requires paid tier)

summary: RoveNotes integration that syncs voice recordings and handwritten notes into the vault as markdown files with embedded audio and transcripts.
